clinical.title: STI Testing, Treatment, and Prevention
clinical.summary: Comprehensive STI testing, treatment, and prevention, including doxycycline post-exposure prophylaxis, in a diverse Northern Manhattan sexual health program.

clinical.title: HIV Prevention
clinical.summary: PrEP and PEP delivery and counseling to prevent HIV among adolescents, young adults, and others at risk.

clinical.title: HIV Care
clinical.summary: Longitudinal HIV care as an infectious diseases attending at NewYork-Presbyterian/Columbia, including long-acting injectable antiretroviral therapy.

clinical.title: Project STAY
clinical.summary: Director and Principal Investigator of a youth-focused sexual health program providing clinical care, HIV and STI prevention, and outreach across New York City.

education.title: NYC STI/HIV Prevention Training Center
education.summary: Principal Investigator and Co-Medical Director of a CDC-funded center delivering clinical training and capacity building for providers across five states and two territories.

education.title: Fellowship SOC Co-Director
education.summary: Co-Director of the Infectious Diseases Fellowship Scholarly Oversight Committee, mentoring pre- and post-doctoral trainees in HIV and STI research.

education.title: Resident and Fellow Education
education.summary: Recurring lectures on sexual health, PrEP, PEP, and empiric antibiotics across internal medicine, pediatrics, and emergency medicine.

education.title: Medical Student Teaching
education.summary: Annual STI lecture and small-group facilitation in the Microbiology and Infectious Diseases course for second-year students at VP&S.
